A deferred intention to set thresholds in a future version becomes a stated present-tense threshold, answer rate under 1 in 20 on a SecureBio-built benchmark (dims 2 and 4). Further thresholds stay deferred at the same 'plan to' rung, so no dimension weakens.

Renaming (RMF to FAIF) and rewording only; 'including catastrophic risks' names a subset the RMF already covered through its catastrophic malicious use and loss of control focus, and 'xAI's AI models, such as Grok' equals 'AI models such as Grok'. No dimension moves.

'Plans to' review becomes 'will' review (dim 4, modal drift rule). 'Continuously' to 'periodically' sets no defined cadence in either version, and 'adjust' to 'expect significant changes' stays at the intend/expect rung, so no dimension weakens.

The standards list is introduced by 'such as', so dropping the Frontier Model Forum item and the WMDP alignment example is an illustrative change (rule 11.2); the rule text, evaluation during annual reviews and integration into benchmarks and safeguards, keeps its force and scope. Not material.

The benefit-outweighs-risk override disappears, narrowing the override condition (dim 6).

Internal rollout is covered by v_next's gate on 'the use of the model', and 'these evaluations' refers to the section 2.2 process, which includes benchmark and safeguard-sufficiency assessment.
